subject: [PATCH 25/60] mm/mempolicy: queue only common memory for mbind() and migrate_pages()

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series appears to be a significant improvement over the current memory policy handling. However, it is unclear whether the changes are sufficient to address all potential issues without introducing new problems.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve memory policy handling in the Linux kernel by optimizing the queueing of folios for migration and binding. The first patch, [PATCH 25/60], specifically targets the mbind() and migrate_pages() functions, modifying them to only consider common memory when queuing folios. This change is intended to prevent unnecessary failures during migration.
